annotations.title: Buy a basket of stock tokens

description: Build unsigned buys of several stock tokens on Robinhood Chain, paid with the ETH in `wallet` and signed on one keyfo page. Use it when the user asks for more than one stock at once, like “buy $100 of Mag 7” or “split $50 across NVDA, TSLA, SPY”; for one stock, use build_trade. Give exactly one of: `legs` (each stock with its own `usd` or `eth`), or `preset` or `split` (a list of tickers) with `usd` or `eth` for the whole basket, shared equally. Preset mag7 is 7 separate stock tokens in equal shares (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA, META, TSLA), not an index or a fund. 2 to 10 stocks, at least $1 each, up to 10 ETH in total, and the ETH plus gas must already be in `wallet`. Buys only. No keyfo fee; the route’s fees are in fees_usd. The calls expire at valid_until. The page asks for one signature only if the user’s wallet signs batches (MetaMask after a one-time account upgrade); otherwise it asks once per buy, and some buys may go through while others do not, so never promise one signature. To buy the rest later, check stock_portfolio and build only the stocks not bought. If the error has needed_slippage_pct, name the stocks and ask the user before you use it. No keyfo tool signs. When you reply, list each stock and its amount. The answer also has sign_url: a keyfo page where the user checks the transaction and signs it in their own wallet. It stays open for 15 minutes and gets a new quote itself when the price is out of date. Show that link to the user, and never ask them to paste the transaction data anywhere.
